featured_reviews.name: Gauri kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I first joined Prenatal Yoga with Ganesh Sir, and it truly helped me stay active throughout my pregnancy and even during recovery after delivery. The breathing exercises I learned became my biggest support during labor — they helped me stay calm and made the whole birthing process much smoother.

After delivery, I joined back again for postpartum recovery and to gradually return to my regular exercise routine. The sessions are designed to start from the very basics and progress to advanced levels. Both Radha Ma’am and Ganesh Sir explain everything so well — from why a particular exercise is done, when it should be done, its benefits, and even who should avoid it.

We practice many different types of yoga such as various asanas, Bhakti Yoga, Karma Yoga, and Krida Yoga, which keeps the sessions engaging and never boring. We also do Trataka, a cleansing practice for the eyes, which has really helped me improve my focus.

The breathing exercises have increased my lung capacity significantly — when I first joined, I could barely hold my breath for a few seconds, but now I can sustain it comfortably for much longer.

Another beautiful experience was music therapy conducted by Radha Ma’am. It helped me release emotions and brought a sense of peace and calm within.

The most valuable lesson I’ve learned through these sessions is how to manage my anxiety through breathing exercises.

A heartfelt thank you to Radha Ma’am and Ganesh Sir for their continuous support, guidance, and positive energy throughout my journey! 🙏

I recently completed the 200 hours Yoga Teacher Training Course online with Sayujya Yoga, and it was a truly enriching experience.

Hardik Sir and Prutha Ma’am are exceptional teachers. They are knowledgeable, thorough, and passionate about what they do. They explain concepts with great clarity and attention to detail, ensuring students understand not just the poses but the deeper aspects of yoga, including alignment, anatomy, philosophy, and teaching methodology.

The course was well-structured, supportive, and transformative.
I highly recommend Sayujya Yoga to anyone looking for authentic and high-quality yoga teacher training. Thank you, Hardik Sir and Prutha Ma’am, for your guidance and dedication throughout this journey. 🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: POOJA
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience completing my 6-month weekend Yoga Teacher Training course. The entire journey, from basics to Vinyasa, was taught in such a simple, structured, and practical way that it made learning very smooth and enjoyable.
Before enrolling, I was unsure if I would be able to complete the course, but the supportive and encouraging teaching style made all the difference. Hardik Sir and Prutha Ma’am are truly the best — extremely knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely dedicated to their students’ growth.
This course was not just about learning yoga asanas, but also about self-growth, discipline, and inner awareness. It has brought a positive shift in my lifestyle and mindset.
I’m truly grateful for this experience and highly recommend this course to anyone who wants to start or deepen their yoga journey.

featured_reviews.name: B A
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Sayujya Yoga 🧘 (Hardik Sir & Prutha Ma'am),

Thank you, Sayujya Yoga (Hardik Sir & Prutha Ma'am), one of the best teachers I have ever met after my schooling days. You have a unique and truthful teaching. The first statement, that "Yoga is for all and not the rigid one that you see everywhere", showed me that we all and anyone can fit in, it's just a bit of adjustments that need to be taken care of.

The knowledge you both carry about the Yoga Shashtras is immense. There is a clear, perfect and elaborated answer to every question/doubt raised.  Be it the modern-day lifestyle or the old-school lifestyle, you know how to articulate the logic and the theory of Yoga to everyone in every possible way.
The Asana Practice, which is actually Yoga Sadhana, also had so many different variations, we came to know it here at your school.

As you are aware, I recently finished the 200 hrs(4 months) Yoga Teachers Training program. I feel more than content with what I got in those four months. It was like someone had adopted me as their own.

The best part is your cross-verification that you conduct by taking exams any moment in between the course to check, are we all on this path religiously or just for namesake, also creating constant awareness to bring everyone (batch) together and win over the obstacles that we face in our day-to-day life which eventually pushes us to give up the beautiful soul nourishing lifestyle.

Online class support when unable to reach, then providing class recordings for revision and further improvement is also a beautiful help for us, who are always on the toes with tight schedules in our lives.

The Yoga Retreat trip was an another cherry on the Cake we had in this course, where we could open up and be what we are. this widen the scope of understanding within as well as for the whole group to come closer and get deeper in to the Yoga Sadhana.

Thanks once again Hardik Sir and Prutha Ma'am for bringing back my disciplined and healthy lifestyle. From here on, I am never going to let myself down about anything and will keep moving forward as I usually did before.

featured_reviews.name: Brinda Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Doing my 200-hour TTC at Sayujya Yoga was more than just a certification course for me — it was a truly holistic and grounding experience. The training beautifully balanced asana practice with pranayama, philosophy, alignment, meditation, and self-awareness, making yoga feel much deeper than just physical postures.
What I appreciated most was the sincerity and warmth of the teachers. They created a space where learning felt personal, supportive, and authentic. The environment encouraged discipline, growth, and inner connection without feeling overwhelming.
Over the course, I noticed positive changes not only in my flexibility and strength, but also in my mindset, breathing, and overall awareness. The teachings felt rooted in traditional yoga while still being practical for everyday life.
I’m genuinely grateful to hardik sir and prutha ma'am  for this meaningful journey and would highly recommend it to anyone looking to experience yoga in a more complete and holistic way.

featured_reviews.name: Dhvaniit Sangghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just completed the 200 hrs TTC course with Sayujya Yoga and its been transformative on every level. The pratice had a profound impact on my physical health, mental clarity and spiritual connection. I feel stronger, calmer and more centered.
I feel extremely fortunate to have found Hardik sir and Prutha Ma’am as my first Yoga Gurus. They have thoughtfully structured every session and conduct them in a deeply supportive way. They created a space where everyone felt seen, encouraged questions and offered adjustments without judgements. Their patience and presence made the journey both safe and inspiring.

Highly recommend this course to anyone looking for real growth beyond just asanas. It’s not just yoga, it’s a shift in how you live.

featured_reviews.name: Nandu rapaka
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am delighted to share my experience of completing the 6-month TTC (Teacher Training Course) in Yoga under the guidance of Hardik Sir and Dr.Prutha Ma’am.
Both of them are exceptionally knowledgeable and dedicated teachers. They explained every concept in great depth, ensuring not just understanding but true clarity and practical application. Their teaching approach is structured, patient, and highly inspiring.
This course provides in-depth knowledge and offers a great opportunity to learn and grow in the field of yoga. I gained valuable insights, improved my practice, and developed a deeper understanding of yoga as a discipline.
Their continuous support and encouragement made the entire learning journey smooth and enriching. I would highly recommend this training to anyone who wishes to learn yoga in a comprehensive and professional manner.
Thank you so much, Sir and Ma’am, for your constant guidance, support, and inspiration throughout this journey.

featured_reviews.name: Avani Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Completing this Yoga 200-hour TTC with Hardik sir and Prutha ma'am was one of the most best decision. The program elegantly integrates intense physical asana practice with modifications using props, pranayama, shuddhi kriyas, practices leading to meditation, anotomy and physiology and deep ancient yogic philosophy. The teachers are highly proficient and understanding. Not only this course helped me improve in my physical strength and flexibility but I've noticed a profound shift in my mental health and emotional resilience. Highly recommended for both aspiring teachers and serious practitioners!

featured_reviews.name: Gauravi Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience at Sayujya Yoga. The teaching style of Hardik Sir and Prutha Ma’am truly stands out. They both explain concepts with great clarity and depth. What I appreciated the most was their strong focus on muscle movements and proper alignment in every asana. They also teach the proper use of props, which makes the practice more accessible and helps achieve correct alignment without strain. What makes their teaching even more special is how seamlessly they blend practical asana practice with yoga philosophy. It adds a deeper meaning to the sessions and makes the overall experience more holistic and enriching. Highly recommended for anyone looking to build a strong, mindful, and well-informed yoga practice.
